key.name: custom-command
key.summary: Command to run from the Faceplate menu
key.description: Optional shell command to run from the custom command item in the Faceplate menu.

key.name: default-click-action
key.description: Controls whether clicking Faceplate opens its menu or directly runs the selected launch command.

key.name: launch-command
key.description: Command preset used by the Launch Command menu item and direct click action.

key.name: layout-horizontal
key.description: When enabled, the avatar and name are displayed side by side. When disabled, they are stacked vertically.

key.name: custom-avatar-path
key.description: Optional local image path used instead of the avatar from AccountsService.
